result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, cut-off cards at screen edges, and incomplete content visibility that hurts usability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail; ensure card width accommodates typical names.

issues.description: Horizontal category chips (e.g. Healthy) and the third Fastest card are clipped at the right edge with no clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add padding/safe area, fade edge, or peek of next item so overflow scrolling is obvious and content isn’t hard-cut.

issues.description: Bottom Popular card (pizza) is heavily cut off by the tab bar, hiding most of the image and any title/meta below.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Promo banner and list sections feel cramped; delivery time pills overlay images and may collide on smaller widths.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing between sections and ensure overlay badges have consistent margins and contrast.

issues.description: Inconsistent card corner treatment and image crop (circular food art vs full-bleed photos) makes the grid look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image aspect ratios, border radius, and placeholder style across restaurant cards.
